about_short_description.short_description: Findly helps businesses understand and interact with their data by providing the business intelligence.

product.name: Findly AI
product.description: An AI-driven platform that converts natural language queries into SQL and visual insights, enabling users to interact with business data without technical expertise.

product.name: Semantica
product.description: A co-pilot tool that automates the creation and maintenance of the semantic layer by inferring business metrics and dimensions from data warehouses.

product.name: Findly Dashboard
product.description: A user interface that visualizes data insights generated by Findly AI, offering interactive visualizations, metadata transparency, and error handling.

product.name: Findly AI Chatbot Integration
product.description: An AI chatbot integrated with communication platforms like Slack and Teams that enables users to query data sources such as Google Analytics and Facebook Ads using natural language.

product.name: Agency Partnership Program
product.description: A program offering agencies tools, support, and resources to integrate Findly's AI data analytics into their client services.
